builtInDescriptions.bash: Run a controlled Git Bash command from the active Workspace. The cwd is an initial working directory, not a filesystem sandbox.

availabilityReasons.available: Available in the current Runtime generation.
availabilityReasons.notReported: Runtime did not report this tool.

bash.title: Git Bash configuration
bash.runningDescription: These controls save desired configuration only. A manual override takes precedence and is validated exactly; Auto Detect applies only when no manual path is configured. Runtime validates the selected executable when the next generation starts.
bash.stoppedDescription: Desired configuration is saved for the next Runtime generation. A manual override takes precedence and is validated exactly; Auto Detect applies only when no manual path is configured. Current readiness is unavailable until Runtime reports it.
bash.noSandboxWarning: Bash is not an OS filesystem sandbox.
bash.boundary: Bash uses the active Workspace as its initial working directory. It can still access files outside that directory and the network; Policy, Approval, hard limits, and process ownership are the controls.

policies.title: Policies
policies.description: Edit the next Runtime generation's desired policy and observe the current generation's effective decisions. Runtime compilation remains authoritative.
policies.restartRequiredDescription: Desired policy is saved, but the current Runtime generation is still using its previous snapshot.
policies.toolDefaultsDescription: A default is used only when no enabled User Rule matches. Bash defaults to ASK and remains subject to Runtime analyzer risk floors.
policies.userRulesDescription: Rules are persisted as typed matchers. Bash Command prefixes match exact normalized tokens; they are not regular expressions or substrings.
policies.userRulesHelp: Dynamic or unclassified Bash expressions stay at least ASK. A Tool-level Bash ALLOW is not a filesystem sandbox and does not bypass Runtime approval or risk floors.
policies.approvalBashCommandDraft: Current approval scope: {{scope}}. This Bash Command matcher is a reviewable exact-token draft; creating a rule never resolves the current approval.
policies.approvalBashToolDraft: Current approval scope: {{scope}}. This starts from a Bash Tool ASK draft; review it before saving because creating a rule never resolves the current approval.
policies.approvalToolDraft: Current approval scope: {{scope}}. The persistent M3 tool rule below is broader than this exact scope; review it before saving because creating a rule never resolves the current approval.
policies.name: Name
policies.bashArgvPrefixHelp: Exact normalized token prefix; this is not a regex or substring. Use [] for any argv after the executable.
policies.effectiveDescription: These rows come from Runtime's compiled snapshot. System Guardrails are always read-only.
policies.effectiveUnavailable: Runtime effective policy is unavailable until a generation is running.
policies.invalidSnapshotDescription: Policy-controlled tools are denied until a valid snapshot is compiled by the next Runtime generation.
policies.noCompiledUserRules: No User Rules compiled in this generation.
policies.approvalDraftPrepared: Approval scope prepared as a policy draft. Review and save it explicitly.
